description: Bangladesh: Cox's Bazar Existing and planned access road network of all Rohingya refugee camps is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Inter Sector Coordination Group. This shapefile (GIS) contains the existing and planned access road network of all Rohingya refugee camps including vehicle road, main path, footpath, military constructed Road and Planned roads. Coverage: Bangladesh. The portal files it under the publisher Inter Sector Coordination Group. Its tags are geodata, refugee crisis, refugees, roads, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-04-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
